title: Bjarni Herjólfsson sights America, c. 986
summary: Bound from Iceland for his father's farm in Greenland, Bjarni was driven off course by northerly gales and fog. He raised three unknown coasts, a wooded one, a flat one and a glaciated one, and would not let his crew land on any, before reaching Herjólfsnes. By the saga, no European had seen North America before.

legs.source: Saga of the Greenlanders: three days out of sight of Iceland, bound west
Saga of the Greenlanders: many days in fog under a north wind
legs.doubt: The saga gives days, not a course; the line is a broad brush for the drift, and reading the first coast as Newfoundland is Tryggvi Oleson's.

legs.source: Saga of the Greenlanders: two days north to a flat, wooded land
Saga of the Greenlanders: three days to a high, glaciated land
legs.doubt: The saga gives days and a high, glaciated, island-like land, not a place. The mark stands off the Torngat Mountains, which its three days fit better; Tryggvi Oleson reads the coast as Baffin Island.

legs.source: Saga of the Greenlanders: four days before a south-west wind to Herjólfsnes

events.label: First land sighted
events.text: A low, wooded country with hills. Bjarni knew it did not fit what he had been told of Greenland, and he turned away north. Where it lay is argued: Newfoundland, southern Labrador or Nova Scotia.

events.label: Second land sighted
events.text: A flat land, thick with woods, taken for Labrador. His crew asked to land for wood and water, and Bjarni refused.

events.label: Third land sighted
events.text: A high land of glaciers that Bjarni judged an island with nothing to offer. The mark stands off the Torngat Mountains of northern Labrador, the reading the three days fit best; Tryggvi Oleson read it as Baffin Island. Leif Erikson later bought his ship and sailed to find these coasts.

events.label: Herjólfsnes
events.text: Bjarni raised his father's farm on the south-west coast of Greenland after four days before a strong wind. He never set foot on the new coasts: they were seen, not landed on.
